channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about DeAndre Jordan | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about DeAndre Jordan from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Blake Griffin, DeMarcus Cousins, DeAndre Jordan, Steven Adams, Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
Karl-Anthony Towns:

“I would say the person that's toughest is probably going to be like DeMarcus Cousins or Steven Adams. I've probably in my life ever had to tag the roller. During defense, you're on the other side and you come over to tag the roller to hold him up so he doesn't DeAndre Jordan, alley-oop dunk, Blake Griffin, alley-oop dunk like that, Mitchell Robinson, alley-oop dunk. You try to slow down the roller so it makes it easier to deal with the pick and roll, the player, two offensive players and the two defensive players. It makes it easier and gives them more time to figure out the situation with the PNR.”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Blake Griffin, DeMarcus Cousins, DeAndre Jordan, Steven Adams, Mitchell Robinson, Oct 17, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: James Borrego on DeAndre Jordan
item.description:
Pelicans coach James Borrego said.

“The beauty in DeAndre is, whatever is required in the moment, he’s willing to step and give.“And sometimes that’s an X or O or it’s just love. And that’s not easy to do. That’s what makes him so special.”

James Borrego on DeAndre Jordan, Mar 16, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Michael Malone on DeAndre Jordan
item.description:
DeAndre Jordan is working these days.

“We’ve kind of settled into our backup five right now with DJ, so I think that helps. You know. ‘Is it Dario (Saric)? Is it Zeke (Nnaji)? Is it DJ?’ Right now, it’s DeAndre Jordan,”

Michael Malone on DeAndre Jordan, Dec 26, 2024. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Reggie Jackson on DeAndre Jordan
item.description:
Jackson told Yahoo Sports on Sunday.

“I told him, ‘I was living vicariously through you.’ Myself, [DeAndre Jordan], a couple vets, we couldn’t say anything for a couple minutes. It’s so close.”

Reggie Jackson on DeAndre Jordan, Jun 12, 2023. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Doc Rivers on DeAndre Jordan, Paul Reed
item.description:
Doc on the decision to go with Paul Reed over DeAndre Jordan off the bench:

“It wasn’t much of a decision for us. Paul basically played the same role that he played in the first two games and that’s where we liked him, coming off the bench and matching him up in those minutes.”

Doc Rivers on DeAndre Jordan, Paul Reed, May 7, 2022. Source: Twitter @NBAKrell.

item.title: Blake Griffin on DeAndre Jordan
item.description:
Griffin said Monday at practice, his first time speaking publicly since the Nets minimized his role.

“A lot of the guys from last year reached out. [Jordan] did a really great job with it. I told him that. That is how I am going to try to do it as well.”

Blake Griffin on DeAndre Jordan, Nov 30, 2021. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Blake Griffin on DeAndre Jordan
item.description:
Griffin cannot help the team on the court, so he is trying to see how he can contribute from afar.

“I have had great examples, DeAndre last year — he is a guy that I talked to, that reached out,”

Blake Griffin on DeAndre Jordan, Nov 30, 2021. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Blake Griffin on DeAndre Jordan
item.description:
“DeAndre last year, he is a guy that I talked to that reached out. A lot of the guys from last year reached out. He did a really great job with it. I told him that. That is how I am going to try to do it as well.”

Blake Griffin on DeAndre Jordan, Nov 29, 2021. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Chris Bosh on Brook Lopez, DeAndre Jordan
item.description:
Chris Bosh:

“Shoot it. That’s it. Shoot it. Shoot it. That’s all he needs to do is shoot it, I’m telling you. I did it for 13 years in the league, man, and it didn’t steer me wrong. Shoot it. He has the playmaking ability, he is unselfish. It’s wonderful that he’s a team player. But for him to get to where he wants to go, he’s going to have to shoot the ball. I think he’s more than capable. Once he proves that he’s a threat out there, Brook Lopez and DeAndre Jordan and all those bigs, they can’t just be in the middle of the paint playing traffic cop. He needs to come back and he needs to shoot it until they guard him. That would be my recommendation.”

Chris Bosh on Brook Lopez, DeAndre Jordan, Aug 30, 2021. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Vince Carter on DeAndre Jordan
item.description:
“If you’re gonna go get three guys who really demand the ball, that gets tough after a while. One if not two guys of your Big 3 tend to become unhappy sometimes. If they buy into that, then it’s a possibility. If they don’t, then a Big 3 doesn’t work. You just have three big names who really can’t co-exist because they all want to be alpha dogs. I think that’s the biggest thing. You have to bring a Big 3 that can coexist and complement each other.“I feel like a guy like DeAndre Jordan, somebody like that putting pressure on the rim. It’s not enough basketballs out there if you put three big names out there on the floor, so it takes a lot to think about.”

Vince Carter on DeAndre Jordan, Sep 27, 2020. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Kyrie Irving, DeAndre Jordan, Spencer Dinwiddie
item.description:
“We've got a new, fresh team with me, Kyrie Irving, DeAndre Jordan, Spencer Dinwiddie, a lot of guys on our team that our veterans,”

Kevin Durant on Kyrie Irving, DeAndre Jordan, Spencer Dinwiddie, Sep 10, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Sasha Vujacic on DeAndre Jordan
item.description:
“I'm in the best shape of my life right now. I work out every summer with DeAndre Jordan, and he said the same thing. I'm 35, but I feel like I'm 25.As long as I have that desire and fire inside of me, I'm going to keep pushing.”

Sasha Vujacic on DeAndre Jordan, Oct 27, 2019. Source: Los Angeles Times.

item.title: Caris LeVert on DeAndre Jordan
item.description:
“I felt like last year we were a good team but people didn’t really seeit. Because we weren’t really on TV that much and people didn’t really watch the Nets like that. This year, with obviously KD, Kyrie and DeAndre [Jordan], I feel like naturally, we’ll get more attention as a team. I’m super competitive, so I love being my best when my best is needed.”

Caris LeVert on DeAndre Jordan, Oct 9, 2019. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Kyrie Irving, DeAndre Jordan
item.description:
Kevin Durant on his decision to sign with the Nets:

“The organization, basketball is the most important thing for me, so playing with Kyrie (Irving), DeAndre Jordan, the young players they got, was key. Playing with Golden State, playing with an older group. I thought it was time for me to kind of impose my will on a younger group.... I just wanted to be around a nice group of young players and also a good mix of vets.”

Kevin Durant on Kyrie Irving, DeAndre Jordan, Oct 8, 2019. Source: SportsNet New York.

item.title: Garrett Temple on DeAndre Jordan, Spencer Dinwiddie
item.description:
Garrett Temple:

“Kyrie just turned 27, so he still has another four or five years in his prime. The rest of the guys are so young – Spencer, Joe, Caris (who’s a really talented young guy), Jarrett. Then, you add in DeAndre, who’s a great vet, and KD coming back next year… There’s a lot to look forward to with this team.”

Garrett Temple on DeAndre Jordan, Spencer Dinwiddie, Jul 28, 2019. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: David Fizdale on DeAndre Jordan
item.description:
“(DeAndre) sees a situation as a good situation for this year, having a real purpose, and possibly in the future. He’s like having another coach on the bench.”

David Fizdale on DeAndre Jordan, Mar 2, 2019. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on DeAndre Jordan
item.description:
Dwain Price:Carlisle on DeAndre:

“He didn’t come here to lose games. This is a big move for him to make after being some place for over a decade, so he’s really into it. He’s doing a lot of really important things from a leadership standpoint -- accountability and things like that.”

Rick Carlisle on DeAndre Jordan, Oct 22, 2018. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on DeAndre Jordan
item.description:
Dirk Nowitzki on coming off the bench:

“I spent most of my time playing five because of movement issues, we call it. When we signed DeAndre, it was pretty much clear in my head that I would come off the bench.”

Dirk Nowitzki on DeAndre Jordan, Sep 21, 2018. Source: Twitter @ESefko.

item.title: Harrison Barnes on DeAndre Jordan
item.description:
Eddie Sefko:Harrison Barnes on what he thought of DeAndre Jordan's jilting of the Mavericks three years ago:

“I never thought all of us would be on the same team.”

Harrison Barnes on DeAndre Jordan, Sep 21, 2018. Source: Twitter @ESefko.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on DeAndre Jordan
item.description:
Dwain Price:Dirk on @DeAndre Jordan :

“I think he's going to fit in great with coach's system. The (center) is always running and rolling and protecting the rim, so we're looking forward to him really fitting in.”

Dirk Nowitzki on DeAndre Jordan, Sep 15, 2018. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on DeAndre Jordan
item.description:
“Obviously, DeAndre's going to be our starter at the five position and the rest will just kind of fall in place after that,”

Dirk Nowitzki on DeAndre Jordan, Sep 14, 2018. Source: Dallas Morning News.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on DeAndre Jordan
item.description:
Rick Carlisle on DeAndre Jordan:

“I was with him yesterday in LA. I spent a couple of hours with him and had a real constructive visit with him. We worked on a few things. I'm just so excited that he's on board with us. He's going to be great.”

Rick Carlisle on DeAndre Jordan, Jul 26, 2018. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Harrison Barnes on DeAndre Jordan
item.description:
Dwain Price:Harrison Barnes on the @Dallas Mavericks acquiring DeAndre Jordan:

“I love it. I think DJ helps us fill a lot of areas that we needed.”

Harrison Barnes on DeAndre Jordan, Jul 9, 2018. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Mark Cuban on DeAndre Jordan
item.description:
Dwain Price:Mark Cuban on DeAndre Jordan:

“He's a rim runner, pick-and-roller. He's a defender, he's a rebounder. He’ll be the best rebounder in Mavs history the minute he walks on the court. No disrespect to Tyson (Chandler) and some of the guys who came before him.”

Mark Cuban on DeAndre Jordan, Jul 6, 2018. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on DeAndre Jordan
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Rick Carlisle on burying the hatchet with DeAndre Jordan:

“There was no need. There just wasn’t. Sometimes things take a while to happen. Sometimes you have obstacles, you work through them and figure it out. That’s what we did.”

Rick Carlisle on DeAndre Jordan, Jul 6, 2018. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Chris Paul on DeAndre Jordan
item.description:
Paul told USA TODAY Sports.

“(About) everything. Life, hoop, everything. But I talk to him just about every day. Seriously … I always wish (the Clippers) the best, but for me – DeAndre, I talk to DJ literally about every day. And Jason Powell, who’s the head trainer, I talk to him almost every day too.”

Chris Paul on DeAndre Jordan, Dec 2, 2017. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on DeAndre Jordan
item.description:
Frank:

“DeAndre was never, ever dangled out there(&) is a cornerstone to what we do. ...DJ is going to be here for a long, long time”

Lawrence Frank on DeAndre Jordan, Jun 23, 2017. Source: Twitter @billoram.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on DeAndre Jordan
item.description:
Arash Markazi:Lawrence Frank on DeAndre Jordan:

“We love D.J. D.J. is going to be here for a long, long time as far as we're concerned.”

Lawrence Frank on DeAndre Jordan, Jun 23, 2017. Source: Twitter @ArashMarkazi.

item.title: Chandler Parsons on DeAndre Jordan
item.description:
“How DeAndre was kind of starting to get shady and ignore Mark's calls, that's kind of like what Mark started doing to me. So it was like, 'Damn, you know what? I get it. We're going through negotiations. I know free agency can be tough sometimes, but at the end of the day, you're my friend.'”

Chandler Parsons on DeAndre Jordan, Nov 18, 2016. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Blake Griffin, DeAndre Jordan, Kevin Garnett
item.description:
Doc Rivers on Kevin Garnett's presence at Clippers training camp:

“KG was phenomenal today. This morning, before practice, he had a teaching clinic that you would pay a lot of money to see. It was great. It was great for Blake [Griffin] and [DeAndre Jordan] and the young guys as well. It's great to have him around. He's a great teacher. We know him as a great player. I knew him as a great teacher. He'll be really good for us.”

Doc Rivers on Blake Griffin, DeAndre Jordan, Kevin Garnett, Sep 29, 2016. Source: Twitter @jovanbuha.
